title: Christmas Spirits (BBC)
paragraphs: A Golden Radio Hour collection of BBC Christmas-season supernatural and ghost dramas. The recordings come from different productions, so they are presented as a themed collection rather than one original series.

Curated preservation compilation of 22 unique BBC radio ghost, horror and supernatural items spanning 1962-2014. It is not one historical BBC series: objects originate in multiple series, readings, stand-alone plays, serials and later omnibus presentations. The source collection page has 23 download entries because one Luke Sutherland item appears twice; the frozen GRH set keeps one unique object.
GRH documents the program through BBC Christmas supernatural preservation compilation (December 24, 1962 to December 20, 2014) on [[org|org.deepv2.f713a484394d0d32|BBC Radio]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Alec McCowen (performer on 2 recordings), Charles Lefeaux (producer on 2 recordings and radio adaptor on 1 recording), David Hunter (director on 2 recordings), Sheila Grant (performer on 2 recordings), Ann McKay (producer on 1 recording), Ballard Berkeley (performer on 1 recording), and Bernard Brown (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include Christmas ghost and supernatural story, holiday horror and uncanny experience, cross-series BBC preservation compilation, literary work adapted or read for radio, original BBC radio drama, and radio reading and narrated story.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including BBC Radio 4 Christmas Spirits strand, BBC Radio 5 The Woman in Black serial, Mysterious Circumstances source productions, and Fear on 4 Christmas horror contributions.
